text:
A quiet Sunday, and nothing announced yet for the week ahead, which is the cheapest moment there is to get ahead.

**Monday** is your one open afternoon. **Tuesday** runs Jr. Thespians straight into Tae Kwon Do, Tae Kwon Do comes back **Wednesday** and **Thursday**, and **Friday** ends with Crochet Club. Whatever you want done this week goes best on Monday.

Pick one shelf and give it twenty minutes tonight or tomorrow. A lesson finished before anyone asks for it is the easiest kind.
